name: Stack/breeching dampers, bypass dampers and sealing systems for HRSG simple-cycle operation
description: Diverter/bypass damper systems route gas-turbine exhaust either to the bypass stack (simple cycle, HRSG offline) or through the HRSG (combined cycle), with mechanically interlocked isolation and seal-air systems so personnel can enter the isolated HRSG while the turbine runs. Stack dampers slow HRSG cooling between starts, prevent rain ingress and provide overpressure relief.

specifications.unit: degrees: open damper locked >80 degrees while mating damper closes >10 degrees
specifications.basis: Forney article; mechanical interlock requires one damper at least 80% open so turbine exhaust cannot be fully blocked

specifications.metric: Forney seal-air fans and allowable entry temperature
specifications.unit: fans at 200% capacity; seal-air curtain designed to maintain temperatures below 140 F (OSHA confined-space requirement) for HRSG entry
specifications.basis: Forney article; truss blade cavity forms air-seal plenum, flexible seal packs at blade tips

specifications.metric: Carbon packing temperature limit and shaft material
specifications.unit: degrees C (753 F) oxidising temperature limit for carbon components; 17-4PH stainless shaft
specifications.basis: Forney article; purged lantern ring prevents exposure to corrosion and temperature above the oxidising limit
